create_agent: create a Claude, Codex, or Mock coding agent using the _create_agent factory function
run_claude_agent: run a Claude-backed coding agent with a prompt, workdir, and phase name
run_codex_agent: run a Codex-backed coding agent via subprocess with prompt logging and output capture
parse_agent_result: parse an agent response string into an _AgentResult with extracted JSON or parse errors
extract_json_block: extract a JSON object from a markdown code block or raw JSON string in agent output
